Railway Minister Orders Mission-Mode Action on Signalling Deficiencies

Union Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw has directed officials to address signalling deficiencies in a 'mission mode' approach. The directive aims to rectify issues related to railway signalling and maintenance. Negligent suppliers involved in these deficiencies may face permanent blacklisting. The focus is on a swift and comprehensive resolution of the identified problems within the railway network.
